source_work: The Religious Ideas of the Arunta
source_operation: Compares conflicting reports; solicits new field correspondence; tests missionary chronology, translation, diffusion, and internal evolution as rival hypotheses; assigns burden of proof for borrowing
lovejoy_operation: Separates missionary/contact influence from earlier material; tests date/provenance; distinguishes imported moralization from local non-moral determinants
evidence_limit: No evidence Lovejoy read Thomas 1905; Thomas's method also reflects post-Paris networks

source_operation: Separates classification by outward form from inward meaning; states present meaning need not equal original cause; allows transformation and syncretism
lovejoy_operation: Refuses to infer sacrificial/mystical meaning from outward form; treats syncretism and changing explanations historically
evidence_limit: Later formalization; not evidence of exact Marillier wording

source_operation: Calls cannibalism a grouping whose common bond is only eating flesh; classifies by motives and regulations; quality-transfer is magic; critiques Steinmetz endo/exo boundaries; multiple origins
lovejoy_operation: Separates famine, revenge, affection, transfer, magic, propitiation, communion; body-part quality transfer need not be communion; sacramental union exceptional
evidence_limit: No Thomas-to-Lovejoy reading claim; 005 predates article

source_operation: Disaggregates indwelling spirit, charm power derived from a spirit, and object magically potent in itself
lovejoy_operation: Distinguishes fetish by indwelling/present spirit from charm or amulet with intrinsic efficacy
evidence_limit: Thomas's terminological judgments are later and not identical to 005 vocabulary

source_operation: Separates non-moral taboo from moral obligation; direct/communicated mana; automatic, animistic, and social sanctions
lovejoy_operation: Separates taboo/custom/clan solidarity/ritual qualification from moral guilt; initiation and bodily injury do not automatically imply sacrifice
evidence_limit: Substantive overlap already noted in batch28; value here is integration into common operator

source_operation: Reports Marillier/Hubert-Mauss anti-unilateral theories; says permanence of ritual form does not imply permanence of meaning; original single form insoluble
lovejoy_operation: Separates funerary, magical, fecundative, propitiatory, alimentary, sacramental and social mechanisms; present complexes can mix older layers
evidence_limit: Later synthesis; Marillier primary antecedents must be cited where available

source_operation: Lists rank, sex, mode of death, burial and funeral ritual as postmortem determinants; refuses to infer universal origin from Australia or ancestor cult
lovejoy_operation: Distinguishes social/ritual/natural determinants from moral desert; layers ancestor/local/nature gods and tests priority rather than assuming it
evidence_limit: Later encyclopedia control, not direct transmission evidence

source_operation: Documents receiving/using Marillier notes while explicitly adopting different divisions and point of view
lovejoy_operation: Shares source field but reclassifies determinants and cases differently
evidence_limit: Does not prove Lovejoy received identical physical sheets

lovejoy_operation: Repeatedly moves from surface form to determinant/mechanism, tests negative cases, separates causal bearers, and reconstructs historical layering
